title: ID0412887-DC/Si-D/GB- [MP / R1 170001463] Multiple charging session failed
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
The charger was reported as not working and charging sessions cut out after 10 seconds. I arrived to site and observed the charging session starting but then cutting out multiple times. A note came up on the screen that showed “the current flow was stopped from the vehicle side”.
I checked inside the charger and found the AC socket to be a little lose. I tightened it back up to how it should be.
I rebooted the charger and done another charging session which lasted for 10 mins but then cut out again. I tried multiple times but still couldn't get the charger to function correctly
Root cause:
charger was set to no authentication, but with OCPP active & FW updated to 6.1.3
Solution:
Removed the OCPP active from charger configuration & Charger set to RFID authentication, with FreeVend (automatic authorisation) on the backend, and the problem is resolved.
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Warranty Status:
Active

additional_info.subject: RE: 0412887 - ID0412887-DC/Si-D/GB- [MP / R1 170001463] Multiple charging session failed CRM:02023000544
additional_info.body:
Dear Samuel & Jason,
Wishing you a great start to the week!
We performed a few remote configurations/activities, as outlined below, which helped resolve the issue.
On site technician has updated the charger from FW V3.2.8→ 4.0.11→ 5.0.23→FW V 6.1.3
Charger was examined by RC support and NOC, and it was noted that the charger was set to no authentication, but with OCPP active. The OCPP backed was set to authenticate on RFID, and at the status/heartbeat interval of 5 minutes the backend was sending an "unauthorised session" termination, which stopped the charge. Charger set to RFID authentication, with FreeVend (automatic authorisation) on the backend, and the problem is resolved.
Could you send a site report here so we can proceed with closing this ticket?
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
